info.title: Freehold API
info.description: Governed memory backend for AI agents, built on the Allod format.

prior.description: Hash of the changeset being superseded

basis.description: How the classification was derived; manual assertions skip the envelope rule

policy_yaml.description: Complete replacement policy document (YAML or JSON)

agent.description: Authoring agent principal; omitted means the owner proposes

subject.description: The existing node this proposal targets, with its resolved title; null for creates

method.description: Provenance method (model-assisted, manual, etc.) or null for unrecorded

approval.description: approval field; maps from the `status` query parameter

defaultAgent.description: Default MCP agent name, if set

owner.description: The graph's owner principal; console edits sign as this name

graphs.description: Slim list of registered graphs (id, name, kind)

path.description: Absolute path to the repo checkout

id.description: Registry slug id; defaults to basename of path

lastPollAt.description: ISO timestamp of last successful poll

mode.description: Credential mode uses gh CLI token discovery

pushSkipped.description: True when push was not attempted because auto-push is off or no remote is configured.

title.description: Display title derived from attributes (title, name, statement, first line)

truncated.description: True when the node cap cut the listing short
True when file exceeded 512 KB read limit

binary.description: True when a NUL byte was detected in the first 8 KB

size.description: File size in bytes (full file, not truncated)

get.description: Most recently indexed memories, newest first. Same result shape as recall (score is 0). The `status` query param maps to the `approval` field. With `scope=all`, returns the full workspace index instead — every non-meta node including pending proposals, as MemoryIndexEntry — and the other query params are ignored.

schema.description: Set to `all` for the full workspace index (MemoryIndexEntry shape)

200.description: Recent memories with provenance, or the full index with scope=all

get.description: All non-meta nodes and the typed edges between saved nodes, for the graph canvas.
Semantic + full-text search fused via RRF. The `status` query param maps to the `approval` field in RecallResult.

schema.description: Filter by approval state — maps to the `approval` field on RecallResult

get.description: Returns non-secret Freehold configuration (defaultAgent, embedder, port). The bearer token is NOT returned here — it is injected as a meta tag by the server.

400.description: Validation error or invalid repo path

get.description: Nested directory tree of all indexed SourceFile nodes. Only available for repo graphs.
View a single SourceFile with its declared items. 404 if path is not indexed.

400.description: Not a repo graph, or missing path param

get.description: Single code item (function, class, etc.) with callers and callees.
Maps policy rules to the file paths they match via git_checklist.
Nodes and edges one hop from the given file path.

400.description: Not a repo graph or missing path param

get.description: Read raw file content from the checkout working tree. Binary files return content:"". Files over 512 KB are truncated.

400.description: Not a repo graph, missing path param, or path traversal attempt

get.description: Lists all branch-head commits as proposals with checklist and decided state. Only available for repo graphs.

get.summary: Get a git proposal by sha

post.description: Signs a decision record (approve/reject) via the key backend and appends it to refs/notes/allod-decisions.

400.description: Not a repo graph or validation error

409.description: No signing key for the given principal (code: key-missing)

post.summary: Post a code review for a git proposal
post.description: Creates a review/Review@1 node and optional review/ReviewComment@1 nodes with part_of edges.

400.description: Not a repo graph or validation error

get.summary: List reviews for a git proposal
Get per-file full contents for a git proposal
get.description: Returns per-file old and new content for each file changed in the commit. Binary files have empty content strings. Files over 512 KB are individually truncated. Only available for repo graphs.

400.description: Not a repo graph or invalid sha

post.description: Pushes refs/notes/allod-decisions to the graph's origin remote. Returns {pushed:true} on success or {pushed:false, pushError} on failure.

400.description: Not a repo graph or no remote configured

put.summary: Configure the connector in credential mode

400.description: Not a repo graph or invalid body

409.description: No credential found or missing origin remote
